name: Cursor Glow
description: A framework-free Web Component that lights a region around the pointer: one gradient whose centre is two custom properties, written at most once a frame and never while the pointer is still.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A dark panel that lights around the pointer and fades out where the pointer left it.

variants.name: Content
variants.description: A light over words, a link and a button, all of which keep working underneath it.

variants.name: Grid
variants.description: Four regions side by side, each lighting only while the pointer is inside it.

variants.name: Tuning
variants.description: Size, strength, ink, fade, and what blending does on a dark surface.

variants.name: States
variants.description: Over a picture, inside a scrolling box, and what touch and reduced motion leave.
